_help: How this project runs each exit gate from the gate library (shared/references/context/loop-controls.md). scaffold-project.sh and /bmad:onboard fill `run` from the build files via `bmad-gate.py detect --write` and mark it `"detected": true`; the Tech Lead reviews every command at sprint planning, drops the flag and fills any gap. `run` = a shell command whose exit 0 means the gate passed. `verdict: true` means the gate is satisfied by the review engine's GO for the same commit — ac-checklist is a judgment call, so the reviewer decides it, never the actor. An empty `run` is `missing_project_gate` until the TL declares it. Add a project-specific gate with `"custom": true`.

tests-green.run: (cd engine && ./gradlew test) && (cd platform && ./gradlew test) && (cd frontend && npm test) && (cd ai-service && uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests) && (cd sdks/sdk-java && mvn test) && (cd sdks/sdk-node && npm test) && (cd sdks/sdk-python && uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests)
tests-green.description: Engine, platform, frontend, AI service, and Java/Node/Python SDK tests; stops on the first failing component. Does not include live-stack smoke.

typecheck-clean.run: (cd frontend && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json) && (cd sdks/sdk-node && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json)
typecheck-clean.description: TypeScript checks for frontend and Node SDK. Lint and Python static checks are not covered.

build-green.run: (cd engine && ./gradlew assemble) && (cd platform && ./gradlew assemble) && (cd frontend && npm run build) && (cd sdks/sdk-java && mvn package -DskipTests) && (cd sdks/sdk-node && npm run build)
build-green.description: Assemble JVM components and build frontend/Node output; Java SDK package excludes tests handled by tests-green. Python wheel packaging and Docker images are outside this gate.

coverage.description: Coverage report, threshold policy, and enforcing command require TQE review; scaffold metadata is retained in _coverage_policy.
